items.title: Keter Betts interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996
items.q: she asked me to take the bass and go to a school up county in Montgomery County and I went up there... I got a piano player and a drummer and we started doing it.

ctx.x: What’s coming up in the future for you? You’ve got the cruise.

Well just doing a lot of private festivals, kind of like this and so forth. And in the Washington area I’ve been for the last 27 years doing schools, with a trio. It started — this lady, Evelyn Audvin just started me off one day, “I hear you have some kids in school, you just moved to Maryland, and so if you’ve got as many kids as they say you have, you must be nice to kids.” Well that’s got nothing to do with being nice, I mean I know how to get ‘em. But she asked me to take the bass and go to a school up county…
